literal: Board without, game-piece having played, like that indeed: complete book without, assembly taking part.
translation: Taking part in an assembly without complete learning is exactly like playing a game with pieces but no board.
modern: முழுமையான நூலறிவு இல்லாமல் கற்றவர் அவையில் சென்று பேசுவது, கட்டம் வரைந்த பலகை இல்லாமல் வட்டு விளையாடுவதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet uses a vivid analogy to show the futility of an uneducated person trying to participate in a learned discussion. It compares such an attempt to playing a board game ('வட்டு') without the board ('அரங்கு') that defines the rules and spaces. Just as the game pieces have no meaning without the board, a person's words have no weight in an assembly ('கோட்டி') without the solid foundation of complete learning ('நிரம்பிய நூல்'). The emphatic 'ஏ' in 'அற்றே' stresses that the two situations are exactly alike.
